zh.t: 品牌战略升级：Dream 引擎
zh.d: One Work 从这一版起完整运行在自有的 Dream 引擎之上，拥有独立的代码库、构建流水线与更新体系，不再跟随任何开源上游。这是产品换代的分界，也是后续能力扩展的基础。
第一次打开 One Work 不再需要注册模型服务、复制粘贴 API Key。首页点一下「一键体验免费模型」就能拿到一个可以直接对话的模型，每台设备一次；它会作为一条普通的模型服务出现在设置里，随时可以修改或删除。
免费体验模型的入口改为界面角落的常驻推广位，新用户不容易再错过。

zh.t: 对话被中止时给出解释
zh.d: 当一轮对话被系统自行中止时，会用你当前使用的语言说明原因，而不是留下一段没有说明的空白。
内置了文本向量化服务，新建知识库、使用文档检索不再需要单独配置嵌入模型地址。
企业版的治理能力、管理进程与主存储做了结构性重构，为规模化部署打底。个人版的使用体验不受影响。

en.t: A brand milestone: the Dream engine
en.d: From this release, One Work runs entirely on our own Dream engine, with its own codebase, build pipeline and update system, no longer tracking any open-source upstream. This marks the product's next generation and the foundation for what comes next.

en.t: A built-in model, ready out of the box
en.d: Opening One Work for the first time no longer means signing up for a model provider and pasting an API key. One click on "Try a free model" on the home screen gets you a working model, once per device. It lands in Settings as an ordinary model service you can edit or remove at any time.

en.t: The free trial is easier to find
en.d: The entry point for the free trial model is now a persistent promotion in the corner of the interface, so new users are less likely to miss it.

en.t: An explanation when a turn is stopped
en.d: When a conversation turn is stopped by the system itself, One Work now explains why in your current language, instead of leaving an unexplained blank.

en.t: Knowledge bases work out of the box
en.d: A text-embedding service is now bundled, so creating a knowledge base and using document retrieval no longer requires configuring an embedding model endpoint separately.
The enterprise edition's governance features, admin process and primary storage have been structurally reworked to support larger deployments. The personal edition is unaffected.
